Basic Military Training: Initial training undergone by new recruits.
Basic Military Training Centre. Usually what people mean when they talk about Tekong BMT.
Basic Military Training School
Enlistment for recruits classified under PES BP, who undergo a progressive weight-loss-focused BMT track.
Central Manpower Base; the authority responsible for the registration, medical screening, and enlistment of National Servicemen.
A unit which participates in combat operations
The training institution (such as OCS or SCS) where soldiers are trained to become officers or specialists.
(Company) A large group (of 240-50 people, and split into 4 platoons in BMT)
large canvas bag
Warrant Officer (WO)
The formal act of entering military service to begin National Service.
the date of your enlistment into NS
a letter sent to the NSman before enlistment, with the enlistment details
A group of conscripts from the same batch who are enlisted into NS together.
Individual Physical Proficiency Test
Medical officer; the person you go to in order to report sick.

Instead of the standard two-phase system where recruits do BMT at Pulau Tekong and get posted to units later, mono-intake NSFs complete their basic and vocational training primarily aligned with their designated unit.
Compulsory full-time national service for eligible Singaporean men after secondary school.
NS Fitness Improvement Training: the current programme for NSmen who need structured fitness remediation, replacing the older remedial training approach for many IPPT-related cases.

definition: National Service Training Institute (NSTI) at Jalan Bahar.
Officer Cadet School
Pasir Ris Camp is a Singapore Armed Forces training camp located in Pasir Ris, Singapore.
Psychological Care Centre: Staffed by military psychiatrists, it provides mental health evaluations, medical assessments for medical boards (down-pes), and inpatient services

Physical Employment Standards (PES): a medical classification assigned after CMPB medical screening to determine fitness for NS and suitable vocations in the SAF, SCDF, and SPF. For pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027. CMPB is introducing the Refreshed Medical Classification System (MCS) for later cohorts.
PES A: suitable for combat vocations in the SAF, frontline operational vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES B1: suitable for combat vocations in the SAF, frontline operational vocations in SCDF and SPF. Grouped with PES A on the CMPB vocation table.
PES B2: suitable for some combat vocations and combat support vocations in the SAF; some frontline operational and frontline support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES B3: suitable for some combat vocations and combat support vocations in the SAF; some frontline operational and frontline support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES B4: suitable for some combat vocations and combat support vocations in the SAF; some frontline operational and frontline support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
PES BP: fit for Obese BMT in the SAF (Obese BRT in SCDF, Obese POBC in SPF). Recruits are reclassified after completing the programme depending on a review of their Body Mass Index.
PES C2: suitable for some combat support vocations and combat service support vocations in the SAF; some frontline support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES C9: suitable for some combat support vocations and combat service support vocations in the SAF; some frontline support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
PES D: temporarily unfit for grading and pending further review. More time or tests are needed to determine medical fitness, typically about two to three months. Only applicable to pre-enlistees.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES E1: suitable for combat service support and service vocations in the SAF; administrative support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES E9: suitable for combat service support and service vocations in the SAF; administrative support vocations in SCDF and SPF.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: PES F: medically unfit for any form of National Service.
notes: Source: CMPB PES page (https://www.cmpb.gov.sg/before-ns/pre-enlistment-process/medical-screening-and-psychometric-test/medical-fitness/physical-employment-standard--pes-/). Applies to pre-enlistees enlisting before October 2027.

definition: A recruit's or NSman's current Physical Employment Standards (PES) medical classification, used to determine fitness for service and vocation posting.
Passing Out Parade; the parade that marks the end of your basic military training.
Physical training phase: the 2 extra months of BMT done by those who failed or did no attempt their IPPT.
Former programme for NSmen who failed IPPT. Largely replaced by NS Fit for fitness remediation.
Singapore Armed Forces: The military arm responsible for Singapore's defense.
Singapore Civil Defence Force
Specialist Cadet School
Pulau Tekong, the island where Basic Military Training (BMT) is conducted for most Singaporean male conscripts.

Voluntary Early Enlistment Scheme (VEES). This scheme allows medically and physically fit male Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents to begin their 2-year NS before turning 18, provided they are at least 16.5 years old and have parental consent.
The specific military role or job specialty assigned to a national serviceman.
An assessment to determine the suitability of a recruit for elite vocations like Commandos or Naval Diving Unit

Takes place after Basic Military Training (BMT). Postings are determined by organizational needs, medical fitness, and pre-enlistment preferences. Specialized courses range from combat roles to technical and administrative skills
Hydration break during training.
